issues.description: Script sends drawing data and game actions to garticphone.com via WebSocket. No evidence of transmission to third-party servers.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only game-relevant data is sent. No user credentials or sensitive information should be transmitted.

issues.description: Script reads canvas pixel data and manipulates game canvas, but does not collect or transmit user privacy data (cookies, storage, clipboard, form fields, etc.).
issues.recommendation: Continue to avoid collecting sensitive user data.

issues.description: Script uses Proxy to override appendChild and CanvasRenderingContext2D methods, but does not use eval, new Function, or dynamic script injection. No remote code execution detected.
issues.recommendation: Avoid introducing eval or dynamic script loading in future updates.

issues.description: No evidence of code obfuscation or minification. Code is readable and not obfuscated.
issues.recommendation: Maintain code transparency for easier auditing.

issues.description: No DOM XSS or injection detected. User input is not inserted into innerHTML/outerHTML or document.write.
issues.recommendation: Continue to sanitize any future user input before DOM insertion.

issues.description: Script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest and unsafeWindow grants, but only uses unsafeWindow. GM_xmlhttpRequest is not used in code.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused GM_xmlhttpRequest grant to minimize permission surface.

issues.description: No sensitive browser APIs (geolocation, camera, clipboard, notifications) are used.
issues.recommendation: Avoid using sensitive APIs unless strictly necessary.

issues.description: No @require third-party libraries or supply chain risk detected.
issues.recommendation: If adding dependencies, use official CDNs and fixed versions.

issues.description: No evidence of clickjacking or iframe manipulation.
issues.recommendation: Avoid creating hidden iframes or modifying frame protection.

summary: The script primarily automates drawing actions in Gartic Phone and communicates only with the game's official server via WebSocket. No evidence of privacy data collection, code obfuscation, DOM XSS, or supply chain risk. Unused GM_xmlhttpRequest grant should be removed. Overall, the script is safe with minimal risk.
